rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happens or is the case to an extraordinary degree.

example.english: Property prices here are extraordinarily high.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 di1 lau4 gaa3 fei1 soeng4 gwai3

rows.note: Use this colloquial intensifier before an adjective or verb when the extraordinary degree is emphatic and conversational.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 ging6 leng3 wo3

rows.note: Choose this when the extraordinary quality is surprising or unusually noticeable.

example.traditional: 佢哋出奇地咁早就到咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ceot1 kei4 dei6 gam3 zou2 zau6 dou3 zo2
